title: Kestrel and the Vector
author: Elodie Crane
blurb: Petra Fairweather, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
